assumption_register.stress_test: MRS/MSR at EL3 in both selected profiles, including exact system fault frames and real ERET retry.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: The primary rule or an admitted modeled access targets an EC7 exception to EL3 from EL3.

assumption_register.assumption: Guest FPEXC32_EL2 access requires EL2/EL3 and EL1 AArch32 capability, independently of FPTrap selection.
assumption_register.basis: DDI0487B.a D7.2.32; four observed parent failures and final privilege/capability matrices.
assumption_register.dependent_result: Privilege and capability rejection precede operands, higher FP traps and retirement.
assumption_register.stress_test: EL0/EL1 with all32 Rt values in both profiles; EL2/EL3 with EL1 fields1/3/15 and conflicting CPTR controls.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: A denied transfer changes an operand or FPEXC bank, retires, or reaches an FP trap before its capability rejection.
assumption_register.qualification: Bounded evidence for the modeled non-nested profile; no physical A32 conformance claim.

assumption_register.assumption: The alias uses the selected canonical32-bit A32 FPEXC view and the existing system-FP access policy.
assumption_register.basis: DDI0487B.a D7.2.32, the retained FP control pseudocode and the existing primary-derived VfpState masks.
assumption_register.dependent_result: All selected profiles use canonical alias read/write helpers and common higher-control checks.
assumption_register.stress_test: VHE FPEN00/01/10/11, every transfer register, optional trap/short-vector combinations, EL2/EL3 traps, exact ERET retry and source-free A64-to-A32 bank files.
assumption_register.falsification_probe: A64 X1 and A32 R4 disagree after an admitted bank transfer, reserved bits escape, or a denied transfer mutates the bank or retires.
assumption_register.qualification: Finite selected-profile, interpreter/backend/file evidence; broader security/debug profiles remain open.

assumption_register.dependent_result: FPEXC32 source words force managed fallback even if the result is dead.
